how.title: From record date to payout in five on-chain steps

register.title: Register
register.text: Investors pass KYC; the provider attests it on Solana (SAS) and the registrar admits the wallet.

record.title: Record date
record.text: The bond mint is paused and every holder's position is snapshotted on-chain.

entitle.title: Entitlements
entitle.text: Per-holder amounts under 30E/360, rounded half-up, with resident and non-resident tax.

pay.title: Escrow & payout
pay.text: The issuer funds an escrow; payouts run in batches and withheld tax goes to a tax vault.

report.title: Report
report.text: ISO 20022 seev.031 / seev.036 files and a KASE-style notice are generated from chain state.

scenarios.title: The corporate actions a bond actually lives through

coupon.title: Coupon
coupon.text: 1,000 ₸ face, 10% paid semi-annually. Holders of 10, 25 and 65 bonds receive 500, 1,250 and 3,250 ₸.

redemption.title: Redemption
redemption.text: At maturity holders receive the principal plus the final coupon; the bonds are burned and the series is closed.

meeting.title: Bondholder meeting
meeting.text: Holders vote with snapshot weights to raise the coupon from 10% to 12%; quorum and majority are checked on-chain.

early.title: Early redemption
early.text: The issuer calls the bonds early; interest accrued over the 47 days since the last coupon is paid with the principal.

issuers.title: For issuers
issuers.b1: Issue a series from its terms in minutes
issuers.b2: Fund each coupon into escrow — the registrar does the rest
issuers.b3: Call bondholder meetings and change terms with a full audit trail

investors.title: For investors
investors.b1: Holdings, next coupon and every payout with its transaction
investors.b2: Subscribe at par with delivery versus payment
investors.b3: Vote in bondholder meetings from your own wallet

simulated.title: Implemented vs simulated
simulated.note: Meeting thresholds (quorum 50%, approval ⅔ of votes cast) are series configuration, not a statement of Kazakh law.

crash.title: Something broke
crash.body: An unexpected error occurred while rendering this page — try again.

onchain.Unauthorized: this step needs the registrar or paying-agent key — the configured operator wallet does not match
onchain.InvalidAuthority: authority mismatch — the step must be signed by the authority stored on-chain
onchain.InvestorNotActive: the investor record is not Active (never registered or suspended)
onchain.InvestorSuspended: the investor is suspended — reinstate before snapshotting or paying
onchain.SeriesNotActive: the series is not Active (matured or closed) for this operation
onchain.ActionAlreadyOpen: another corporate action is still open — complete or cancel it first
onchain.InvalidDates: dates violate the Almaty-midnight / period rules (record ≤ payment, period = schedule period)
onchain.TooEarly: the on-chain clock has not reached the scheduled time yet — wait and retry
onchain.WrongStatus: the action is not in the status this instruction requires
onchain.MintNotPaused: record date was not struck — the mint must be paused while snapshotting
onchain.MintPaused: the mint is paused for the record window — complete or cancel the action to resume
onchain.AccountMintMismatch: token account belongs to a different mint than expected
onchain.AccountOwnerMismatch: token account belongs to a different owner than expected
onchain.SupplyMismatch: snapshot units ≠ mint supply — a holder is missing, run the snapshot step again
onchain.Underfunded: escrow holds less than Σ net + tax + principal — fund the escrow first
onchain.AlreadyProcessed: already processed — the step is idempotent, nothing to redo
onchain.NothingToDo: nothing to do (e.g. empty snapshot or already-final action)
onchain.MathOverflow: amounts exceed u64 in the integer math — split the batch
onchain.RoundingDrift: per-holder rounding drifted from half-up — snapshot again
onchain.EntitlementCalcMismatch: accrual days do not match the crate day count for the period
onchain.VotingClosed: the voting window has ended — votes are no longer accepted
onchain.VotingOpen: voting is still open — finalize after the deadline or full turnout
onchain.AlreadyVoted: this wallet already voted (one vote per snapshot entitlement)
onchain.NoQuorum: turnout below the quorum threshold — the meeting fails for lack of participation
onchain.NotApproved: meeting result is not Approved — there is nothing to apply
onchain.SupplyNotZero: bond mint supply is not zero — retire every holder before closing the series
onchain.BatchTooLarge: too many holders for one transaction — the CLI batches automatically, retry
onchain.InvalidParams: invalid instruction parameters (e.g. price ≠ face value, or a CHAN announce)
onchain.KycAttestationInvalid: no live KYC attestation (Solana Attestation Service) matching this wallet and its attributes
